newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stocks climb 0.54 pct, hit new year high Athens s.
newsitem.headline: Athens stocks climb 0.54 pct, hit new year high Athens s.

text.p: Greek stocks hit new year highs on Tuesday with the benchmark index rising 0.54 percent to 1,464.75 on the first trading session following the four-day Orthodox Easter recess.
Market watchers said they were confident that Greek stocks were heading higher in the short- and medium-term.

"The market's upside potential is very good and the 1,500 level, a mere way point to year-end targets above 1,700, should be conquered in the coming few sessions," said George Politis, head of institutional sales with Eurosec Securities.
There were indications of increasing foreign buying activity in the Athens bourse which is expected to become stronger in the coming months, brokers said.
"A lower political risk associated with Greece has given rise to large scope for additional placements in Greek stocks by foreign institutionals," he said.
Banks and industrials appear to be the prime targets for domestic and international institutional postfolios.

The Athens general share index ended 0.54 percent or 7.80 points higher on Tuesday, at 1,464.75, from Thursday's close of 1,456.95. It opened at 1459.85 and reached an intra-day and year high of 1,473.64 points at mid-session.
